suites.name: Counting
suites.description: Accumulate past events and act at the right moment.

suites.name: Permanence
suites.description: Track hidden objects through motion and occlusion.

suites.name: Reference
suites.description: Identify the right object or location from its history.

suites.name: Imitation
suites.description: Transfer demonstrated behavior to changed execution conditions.

tasks.name: BinFill
tasks.description: Collect the requested color counts, then stop. Conveyor arrivals and ongoing distractors add counting challenges for hard cases.

easy.robomme: Collect 1–3 cubes across 1 color; stationary objects.
easy.plus: Collect 6–8 cubes across 1–3 colors; stationary objects.

medium.robomme: Collect 2–4 cubes across 1–2 colors; stationary objects.
medium.plus: Collect 3–6 cubes across 2–3 colors; moving objects.

hard.robomme: Collect 3–5 cubes across 1–3 colors; stationary objects.
hard.plus: Collect 3–6 cubes across 3 colors; faster moving objects.

robomme_example.goal: Put two green cubes into the bin and press the button to stop.

easy.robomme: 1–2 swing cycles; no target dodges; always right-first.
easy.plus: 4–7 swing cycles; no target dodges; left- or right-first (seeded).

medium.robomme: 1–3 swing cycles; no target dodges; always right-first.
medium.plus: 3–4 swing cycles; 0–2 target dodges per visit; left- or right-first (seeded).

hard.robomme: 3 swing cycles; no target dodges; always right-first.
hard.plus: 4–6 swing cycles; 0–4 target dodges per visit; left- or right-first (seeded).
